items.scope:
Root Scope: Organizations that are cooperative partners of CERT@VDE.
CNA Scope: Products of CERT@VDE cooperative partners and brands listed at https://cert.vde.com/en/cna/. Also, industrial and infrastructure control systems (and its components) of European Union (EU) based vendors unless covered by the scope of another CNA. Partners and brands include but are not limited to: ADS-TEC Industrial IT, Auma, sipos, Beckhoff, Bender, Bucher Automation, CLAAS, 365FarmNet, Satinfo, Carlo Gavazzi Controls, Codesys, DURAG GROUP, Draeger, Endress+Hauser, Euchner, Festo Didactic, Festo, Frauscher, GEA, HIMA, Harman, Helmholz, Hilscher, K4 DIGITAL, KEB, Krohne, Kuka, Lenze, BHN Services, MB connect line, Miele, Murrelektronik, PHOENIX CONTACT, Etherwan Systems, Innominate, Pepperl+Fuchs, Pilz, SMA, SWARCO, Trumpf, TRUMPF Laser, TRUMPF Werkzeugmaschinen, VARTA Storage, VEGA, WAGO, M&M Software, Weidmueller, Welotec, Wiesemann & Theis, ifm.
All CrowdStrike products.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Kubernetes issues only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Yandex issues only.

items.organizationName: The Browser Company of New York
items.scope: The Browser Company of New York branded products and technologies only.
All Honeywell products.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and Eurotherm.

All Wind River branded products as found on windriver.com including vulnerabilities in natively developed or modified product incorporated components, and only product incorporated third-party components not in another CNA’s scope.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.
Zephyr project components, and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.

items.organizationName: Monash University - Cyber Security Incident Response Team
items.scope: Vulnerabilities in any Monash University developed products, or vulnerabilities identified in third-party vendor products used by Monash University, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Lexmark products only.
All NortonLifeLock product issues only.

items.organizationName: Brocade Communications Systems LLC, a Broadcom Company
items.scope: Brocade products only.
Pure Storage products only.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Danfoss products only.
Vulnerabilities in Honor products and services unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Radiometer products only.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Adobe issues only.
JetBrains products only.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
Citrix issues only.
All HYPR products only.
All ServiceNow products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ServiceNow that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
NVIDIA issues only.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.
All ONEKEY products and vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ONEKEY that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
TIBCO issues only.
